title: relay-run step accepts a ui role and a spec-check role

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `slicer relay-run step --role` accepts only implementer, reviewer, gate, architect or orchestrator (`ROLE_NAMES`, src/slicer/roles.py:31; checked at src/slicer/ops.py:3107). ork's relays run a read-only UI pass on UI slices, in parallel with the reviewer (its matrix row r14, rule u10), and plan a batched read-only spec check before a wave (ork adj 164). Both are recorded today as `reviewer` with a task suffix, so `relay-run list` and the TUI cannot tell them apart. Seen on every UI slice of ork's 2026-10-23..25 run (S33, S84, S65 and more).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/roles.py:31` (ROLE_NAMES) or a separate ledger role set, so the role matrix is not forced to grow rows for these roles.
- `src/slicer/ops.py:3107` (the step role check).
- `src/slicer/cli.py:674` (cmd_relay_run_step help text).
- `src/slicer/tui.py:1530` (RELAY_PIPELINE, if the TUI shows the new roles).
- Relay contract text in `src/slicer/ai.py`, if the UI pass is described there.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `relay-run step --role ui` and `--role spec-check` are accepted and listed under `counts.roles` in `relay-run list --json`.
- An unknown role is still refused with the list of accepted roles.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Decide whether the new names join ROLE_NAMES (and so the matrix) or form a ledger-only set; the ledger-only set keeps `relay-roles recommend` unchanged. Keep `relay-run list --json` backward compatible.

Owner decisions, 2026-10-26: `ui` and `spec-check` form a ledger-only role set accepted by `relay-run step --role`; `ROLE_NAMES`, the role matrix and `relay-roles recommend` stay unchanged.
